allocation.rule: unit = connected component of the bipartite molecule<->matched-core graph (shared molecules, identical canonical molecules and shared matched cores are merged); units that contain at least one pair are placed first, then pair-free units fill the remaining quota; each unit goes to the partition with the largest relative shortfall (target_fraction*n_rows - filled)/target_fraction, ties in the order fit>select>diagnose>audit; ordering is (unit size desc, sha256(salt|unit id) asc)

reported_not_gated.note: the protocol asks for these to be listed; only pairs/components/molecules are hard thresholds
